llm_response.reason: The domain was registered extremely recently (2025-07-27), and all registrant and admin contact information is hidden, which is typical for scam sites attempting to avoid detection. The website uses the well-known Sisley brand name with an Italian localization, mimicking the appearance and structure of a legitimate e-commerce platform, but the legit Sisley Italia should have an older, publicly registered domain. No overt scam features (e.g., fake offers or popups) were seen in the site content, but the combination of impersonation, new registration, and hidden owner data marks this as a likely fake shopping scam.
